messages:
Aisha: Quick async check-in — SLO update: p95 inference latency 210ms (goal 200). Saw 3 alerts overnight (alert#INF-LAT-3). I cleared the transient 503s from batcher; root cause looked like a tokenization spike from a customer test. What I did: rolled kv-cache warmup patch to staging, added extra logging. Blockers: need help verifying warmup rollout on dedicated pool eu-west-1. Today: will run canary in eu-west, follow up on CRs, and re-tune batcher threshold.

Jorge: Thanks Aisha. I can help with canary — free after 11:30 PT. Which pods to target? Also pinged on your CR #3897.

Aisha: Target pods `rf-infer-eu-*` in `redwood-dedicated` namespace. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/serve/pull/3897. Thx.

Nate: FYI ops-bot recreated alert: ops-bot: "ALERT INF-CPU-HIGH: inference-node-7" — I silenced while investigating. CPU spike traced to quantize job on node that shouldn't run on inference pool. I added anti-affinity to job.

Priya: quick note — I left a review on PR 3897 re: retry backoff. Also queue length metrics look ok now.

Aisha: @Jorge please run `kubectl exec -n redwood-dedicated -it rf-infer-eu-3 -- /bin/sh -c \"curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz\"` and paste results.

Jorge: Health OK: `{"status":"ok","uptime":"12d","p95_latency_ms":198}`. Did the canary trigger fallback at 500 tokens?

Aisha: Canary request sample: `{"tokens":600}` — no fallback, but p95 rose to 260ms. I'll revert batching threshold then re-run.

Nate: I'll open TICKET-2034 to track the quantize job affinity change + alert tuning. Assigning to infra team.

Priya: Oncall handover: I will be oncall tonight 00:00–08:00 PT — leaving checklist in /runbooks/ops/oncall-handoff.md. Reminder to keep fallback model policy enabled on high latency.

Aisha: Thanks team. Leaving note: will follow up with perf graphs in ~2h. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: serve:v3.12.1 -> rf-infer-eu-3

Jorge: good luck, i'll monitor logs `kubectl logs -f rf-infer-eu-3 -n redwood-dedicated | grep batcher` and ping if anything odd.

Priya: small ask — can someone approve my small doc update on runbook for alert thresholds? PR 3911.

Aisha: approved. Priya, added :white_check_mark:.

Nate: added TICKET-2034 link: https://tickets.redwood/internal/2034. marking as `needs-docs`.
